extensions.themes: Light values are canonical; colorMeta.<token>.dark holds the dark-theme value where the engine changes it (prefers-color-scheme: dark, or data-theme="dark"). Stage tokens without a dark value are the same in both themes.

lineStyles.name: dashed
lineStyles.purpose: A distinct category line; demo: "Others will see it".

lineStyles.name: dotted
lineStyles.purpose: A distinct category line; demo: "Needs an account".

lineStyles.name: double
lineStyles.purpose: Highest consequence, with red and the solid chip; borders and outlines thicken (3px chip, 4px outline).

icons.family: Inline SVG, 24px grid, 2px round stroke, no fill

headline.purpose: One per step, balanced wrap; 21px under 860px.

title.purpose: Masthead; subtitle in Ink 3 at 450 after a middle dot.

body.purpose: Step body, max 62ch; on-screen control names at 650.

body-small.purpose: Risk note, asides, via line; buttons at 600.

label.purpose: Chips, legend label, list headings, source line; sentence case.

badge-number.purpose: Badge on the stage; 11px on a narrow stage.

shadows.name: spotlight
shadows.purpose: Lit zone: halo rings plus the dimmer; sizes scale by --inv.

shadows.name: spotlight-outline
shadows.purpose: Category outline on the stage; 4px for double.

motion.name: cam
motion.purpose: Camera glide base; 0ms under reduced motion.

motion.name: k
motion.purpose: Per-move multiplier of --cam set by the engine from the distance: 0.45 + distance * 0.8, clamped.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: A new screenshot fades up over the stage.

motion.name: chapter-fill
motion.purpose: Chapter progress bar; none under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion-feedback
motion.purpose: Outline and badge fade-in that replaces the glide.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45em;min-height:2.5rem;padding:0 1rem;border-radius:.5rem;border:1px solid var(--line,oklch(88% .008 95));background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,oklch(22% .01 95));font:600 .9375rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,border-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(45% .15 255);outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary{background:oklch(45% .15 255);border-color:oklch(45% .15 255);color:oklch(99% 0 0)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,oklch(45% .15 255) 88%,black)}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn2{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45em;min-height:2.5rem;padding:0 1rem;border-radius:.5rem;border:1px solid oklch(88% .008 95);background:oklch(100% 0 95);color:oklch(22% .01 95);font:600 .9375rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-btn2:hover{background:oklch(96.4% .006 95)}.ds-btn2:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(45% .15 255);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Category Chips
components.description: Icon + words + line style + tint; solid for the red category.
components.html: Safe to look Needs an account Others will see it Can't undo
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4em;padding:.12em .6em .12em .45em;border:1.5px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 55%,transparent);border-radius:999px;font:600 .8125rem/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 13%,#fff);color:var(--c)}.ds-chip svg{width:1.05em;height:1.05em;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-g{--c:oklch(44% .12 155)}.ds-b{--c:oklch(46% .15 255);border-style:dotted}.ds-a{--c:oklch(47% .12 62);border-style:dashed}.ds-r{--c:oklch(48% .19 27);border:3px double var(--c);padding-block:0;background:var(--c);color:oklch(99% 0 0)}

components.name: Risk Block
components.description: What a click does, under the step title.
components.html: Others will see itleaves a public trace under your name
components.css: .ds-risk{--c:oklch(47% .12 62);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.5rem .875rem;margin:0;padding:.5rem .875rem;border:1px dashed color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 50%,transparent);border-radius:.5rem;background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 13%,#fff);font:400 .9375rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;color:oklch(22% .01 95)}.ds-rchip{padding:.12em .6em;border:1.5px dashed color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 55%,transparent);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--c);font-weight:600;font-size:.8125rem}

components.name: Asides
components.description: note() on Shade; warn() neutral with the alert icon.
components.html:
Tip Stars are public.

Careful A fork appears in your account.
components.css: .ds-aside{margin:0 0 .875rem;padding:.875rem;border-radius:.5rem;background:oklch(96.4% .006 95);color:oklch(40% .01 95);font:400 .9375rem/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif}.ds-warn{background:#fff;border:1px solid oklch(88% .008 95);color:oklch(22% .01 95)}.ds-warn svg{width:1em;height:1em;vertical-align:-.15em;margin-right:.4em;fill:none;stroke:oklch(40% .01 95);stroke-width:2}

components.name: Step Rows
components.description: Chapter step list and cheat-sheet zones: number, title, category mark.
components.css: .ds-rows{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:1px}.ds-row{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.9rem minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:.32rem .45rem;border-radius:6px;font:400 .875rem/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;color:oklch(40% .01 95)}.ds-row:hover,.ds-row[aria-current=step]{background:oklch(96.4% .006 95);color:oklch(22% .01 95)}.ds-row[aria-current=step]{font-weight:600}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(45% .15 255);outline-offset:2px}.ds-n{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:oklch(46% .01 95);font-size:.8125rem}.ds-mark{--c:oklch(44% .12 155);width:1.35rem;height:1.35rem;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 55%,transparent);background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--c) 13%,#fff)}.ds-am{--c:oklch(47% .12 62);border-style:dashed}

components.name: Stage with Spotlight
components.description: Dark lightbox, dimmed screenshot, lit zone with halo, outline and numbered badge.
components.css: .ds-stage{position:relative;height:180px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:oklch(16.5% .012 262);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(30% .012 262),0 10px 30px -18px oklch(10% .02 262 / .6)}.ds-shot{position:absolute;inset:20px 40px;background:oklch(97% 0 0);border-radius:4px}.ds-spot{position:absolute;left:120px;top:70px;width:160px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px oklch(12% .01 262 / .55),0 0 0 4px oklch(12% .01 262 / .9),0 0 0 9000px oklch(9% .01 262 / .7);outline:3px dashed oklch(83% .15 82)}.ds-num{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:26px;height:26px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:999px;background:oklch(83% .15 82);color:oklch(15% .02 262);font:700 13px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px oklch(12% .01 262 / .9),0 2px 6px oklch(5% .01 262 / .6)}

components.name: Chapter Strip
components.description: One segment per chapter, width by share of steps, filled in Tour Ink.
components.css: .ds-ch{display:flex;gap:4px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}.ds-ch li{min-width:max-content}.ds-ch button{width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:.4rem;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:.3rem .5rem .45rem;border-radius:6px;font:500 .8125rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;color:oklch(46% .01 95)}.ds-ch button:hover{background:oklch(96.4% .006 95);color:oklch(22% .01 95)}.ds-ch button[aria-current=true]{color:oklch(22% .01 95);font-weight:650}.ds-ch button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(45% .15 255);outline-offset:-2px}.ds-bar{display:block;width:100%;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:oklch(88% .008 95);overflow:hidden}.ds-bar span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:oklch(45% .15 255)}

narrative.overview:
A tour page is a dark room with one lamp. The screenshot sits on a near-black stage, the camera glides to one zone, everything else drops into shadow, and the lit zone carries an outline in the colour, line style and icon of its category. Beside the room, a calm paper-white reading panel says what the zone is and what a click on it does, in plain words. The page around the stage is quiet so the toured interface is the only loud thing on screen.

The system is built for reading, not for persuading. There is one accent (a near-black graphite for movement through the tour: the Next button, the chapter progress, links), one family of six category tones that exist only to sort zones by consequence, and warm, barely tinted neutrals (hue 95) on the page against a cool blue-black stage (hue 262). Density is moderate: a 17px body at 1.55 line height, a 62ch measure, and the panel capped at 27rem or 40% of the width.

Everything is local and dependency-free: system font stacks, inline SVG icons drawn at a 2px stroke, no web fonts, no images other than the captured screens.
keyCharacteristics: Dark lightbox stage in both page themes; the page itself follows light or dark.
One zone at a time: camera glide, spotlight with a dark halo, a numbered badge.
Categories carry four redundant signals: icon, words, line style, tint.
One global step number across chapters, the same on the badge, the step list and the counter.
One accent for navigation; category tones never double as interface colour.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Colour sorts zones by what a click does. Nothing else on the page is coloured except the navigation accent.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: A category always shows icon + words + line style + tint together, on the stage outline, the chip, the step-row mark and the risk block. Line styles are solid, dashed, dotted and double, and a category keeps the same one everywhere.

rules.name: The Red Line Rule
rules.body: Red is reserved for "can't undo, reaches real users, or data leaves". It goes with the alert icon, the double line and the solid chip. Never use red for an ordinary or merely important zone.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every label, chip and list heading is sentence case at normal tracking. No uppercase, no letter-spaced small caps.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Step numbers, the badge and the "6 of 18" counter use tabular figures so they do not jitter as the reader moves.

rules.name: The Dark Lightbox Rule
rules.body: The stage is near-black in both page themes, so any screenshot reads the same and every outline keeps its contrast. Never make the stage follow the page theme.

rules.name: The Constant Mark Rule
rules.body: Outlines, rings and badges are scaled by the inverse of the camera zoom, so they keep one on-screen size at any zoom.

dos: Do give every category an icon, a label, a line style and a tone, and keep the line style identical on outline, chip, mark and risk block.
Do order categories safest first, and reserve red with the double line and solid chip for "can't undo, reaches real users, or data leaves".
Do keep the stage near-black in both themes, with the halo beside every outline.
Do number steps once across the whole tour and show that number on the badge, the row and the counter.
Do keep feedback under reduced motion: cut the travel, keep the 150ms outline fade.
Do keep chips, labels and headings in sentence case.
donts: Don't show a category by colour alone, or reuse a category tone as interface colour.
Don't add a colour for cautions; `warn()` stays neutral with the alert icon.
Don't let the stage follow the page theme or lose its dimmer and halo.
Don't scale outlines and badges with the camera zoom; keep them at one on-screen size.
Don't put shadows on page surfaces; depth belongs to the stage.
